item.title: Tennessee outlasts LSU to give Rick Barnes 250 wins with Vols
item.description: Veteran coach Rick Barnes celebrated a milestone victory Saturday, as Tennessee’s 73-63 victory over LSU gave Barnes his 250th victory with the Volunteers. Barnes, who is in his 39th season as a head coach and in his 11th season in Knoxville, is now 250-116 at Tennessee.
